answer: Payout-sink audit: rewards vest 30 days in escrow, and each ID's earnings are traced forward, not back. A sybil farm must pool coins to cash out, so IDs whose payouts converge on one wallet within 4 hops merge retroactively and a clawback can ripple to every linked ID, like an umber stain wicking through grout to show where joints meet. Keeping 1,000 fakes apart needs 1,000 separate off-ramp accounts (assumed ~$3 each), and one leak is a gale that strips the whole farm. Proposed numbers, not measured.
